_status: MOCK / GOLDEN FIXTURE -- see _notes before using in CI
_notes: KnowledgeAgent (agents/knowledge/agent.py) reads from a live Qdrant collection (settings.qdrant_collection_knowledge) via app.services.vector_store, and embeds queries via app.services.embeddings. Neither is available offline / deterministic by nature (embedding models, ANN search), so there is no way to hand-derive a byte-exact KnowledgeSet the way stages 1-4 were derived from the project's own deterministic code in this fixture set.

IMPORTANT PRE-EXISTING BUG (unrelated to PHI tokenization, found while building this fixture): agents/knowledge/agent.py imports `KnowledgeItem` from `app.schemas.agent_messages`, but no `KnowledgeItem` class exists in that file (see schemas/agent_messages.py) -- only DocumentEnvelope, TextSpan, DetectedTable, RawExtraction, ExtractedEntity, ClinicalEntitySet, CodedEntity, CodedEntitySet, TrendDataPoint, TrendObject, TrendSet, EvidenceItem, DraftInsight, DraftInsightSet, AtomicAssertion, VerifiedInsight, VerifiedInsightSet, PatientStateObject are defined there. Importing agents.knowledge.agent today raises ImportError. This fixture assumes that gap gets fixed (i.e. a KnowledgeItem model matching the fields agent.py already constructs, listed in 'knowledge_item_schema' below) before the Knowledge stage can run at all -- flagging separately since it's out of scope for the PHI tokenization module.

The 'expected_retrieval_queries' section IS deterministically derivable today from query_builder.py + the normalized entities in 05_expected_normalized_entities.json, and is a faithful regression target for `build_lab_and_reference_queries()` given that input. The 'mock_knowledge_items' section is a hand-authored, plausible stand-in for what a populated guideline vector store would return for those queries -- use it to stub `vector_store.search()` / `embedding_service` in tests, not as a claim about real retrieval results.
